authority: Only the fixed private issuer's immutable request and actual CHILD capsule are accepted as provenance. Byte magic, numeric caller/lease and Graph IDs do not authenticate arbitrary externally supplied state.
problem: The older command2 intentionally binds FS caller104 to outer user lease144. A robust-open/create-mode request has its own caller/action and FS sequence. Relabelling the reply would break the actual peer. New command11 preserves the complete peer request instead of forging a substitute result.

user.transport: Existing HIANDJX1 origin1, 128-byte envelope plus HIANDJ01 USER256 plus payload
user.outer_lease: nonzero existing private outer call lease; distinct from original FS caller
user.payload: Entire original HIANFR03 request256 followed by exactly payloadBytes bytes; min256

FS_request_256.offset32_call: existing FS watermark w216+1, reject exhausted sequence

registered_tokens: Same exclusion as command2. Registered DB file tokens cannot pass to mutating/raw-closing operations; rename checks both token operands. Existing DMS lifetime protection remains independently active.

dispatch.DMS_lease: original request104, not the outer USER lease
dispatch.sole_FS: Existing DMS instance forwards into its original registered FS instance. No new FS or second FD registry is created.

completion.actual_DMS: Existing j_child_shape verifies exact issued source bytes, actual completion frame, scope, action, identity/generation/counters and workspace extent.
completion.actual_FS: Existing j_gateway_frame validates FS scope/call/syscall, opcode, caller, version3, actual source/request and payload extent.
extra_bindings: actual DMS success code/errno are0; actual FS errno is preserved inside FS result
actual DMS workspace768..1023 equals the saved original request header byte for byte
actual DMS source path tail equals the saved original payload byte for byte
completion.result: Original actual FS output prefix[0:256+payloadBytes] copied unmodified, omitting unused output capacity only. Complete raw capacity and workspace remain in the original native trace.
completion.retirement: After output reserve succeeds, accept exact DMS/FS watermarks, publish result and retire USER/source blobs through original j_finish.

grow.before_dispatch: Original j_user reserve does not issue an OS operation before sufficient source/work/output capacity.
grow.after_completion: Same immutable actual CHILD capsule resumes stage62; capacity growth cannot issue another DMS/FS request or repeat completed IO.
grow.compaction: Pointers are reacquired where used after reserve; completion does not reuse an old mutable workspace pointer after compaction.

failure.malformed_request: Permanent outer poison before DMS issue.
failure.malformed_actual_completion: Permanent outer poison; no forged success.
failure.known_FS_errno: Returned inside exact actual FS result; outer remains usable, with actual sequence watermarks committed.

tests_scope: Tests explicitly construct private issued-request fixtures. They exercise real FS syscalls under the unchanged fixed carrier and replay every native entry completely. They do not claim an ordinary/native robust-open or full unixOpen parent has already issued those fixtures.
